baseline.change: Naive full-file text scanning and keyword context assembly without static structural parsing
evidence_sources: Lack of reverse dependency list structure for impact analysis

iterations.name: Babel AST Parser & Symbol Table Extraction
iterations.change: Implemented static AST parsing using @babel/parser and @babel/traverse to extract symbols, exports, API endpoints, and database ORM references
evidence_sources: Line range coordinate extraction for function, class, type, and interface symbols
HTTP route signature parsing (app.get, router.post) and ORM reference detection

iterations.name: Specifier Path Resolver and Directed Adjacency Graph
iterations.change: Implemented multi-extension path resolution (resolveImportPath) and constructed forward/reverse adjacency lists (buildDependencyGraph)
evidence_sources: Forward adjacencyList (source -> target) and reverse reverseAdjacency (target -> dependent) construction
Layer classification of nodes into 5 architectural types (endpoint, db_model, component, utility)

iterations.name: 3-Hop Reverse BFS Change Impact Simulator
iterations.change: Implemented candidate seed node selection and a 3-hop reverse Breadth-First Search (BFS) graph traversal algorithm for downstream change impact analysis
evidence_sources: Reverse BFS traversal bounded to maximum 3 hops from seed nodes
Step-by-step impact chain path construction and bounded code snippet extraction (up to 80 lines)

iterations.name: Subgraph-Grounded Context Retrieval and LLM Integration
iterations.change: Implemented term-scored context retrieval (retrieveContext) and runtime credential loading for LLM Q&A with line citations
evidence_sources: Runtime credential loading from external settings storage
Prompt structure enforcing file path and line number citations backed by retrieved AST subgraphs

final.change: Integrated AST parsing, directed adjacency graph, 3-hop reverse BFS, and grounded LLM RAG into a static codebase intelligence engine
evidence_sources: Line-level AST symbol extraction and citations
Downstream impact path identification up to 3 edge hops
Sanitized prompt context delivery to LLM model
